description: This Python source file provides utility functions to gather Linux distribution release information from various system files and commands, including /etc/os-release, lsb_release, and others. It is mainly used for identifying the Linux distribution and version in a project context.

methods.name: get_os_release()
methods.description: Reads /etc/os-release and returns its key-value pairs as an ordered dictionary.

methods.name: release_dict_osr()
methods.description: Extracts distribution ID and version from /etc/os-release.

methods.name: release_dict_lsb()
methods.description: Runs lsb_release -ir and parses its output into a dictionary with distribution info.

methods.name: release_dict_file()
methods.description: Attempts to read distribution info from various release files if other methods fail.

methods.name: distro_identifier(adjust_hook=None)
methods.description: Generates a normalized distribution identifier string based on available release info, with optional adjustment.
